units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 2:2:2">Y. Gitt. II, 44ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>זה זִיּוּפוֹ מד״א</he> such a document (written in day-time and signed by night) would be defective on account of a condition not perceptible from the document itself, opp. <he>מזוייף מתוכו</he>, v. <cite ref="G00223"><he>זוּף</he> I</cite>.
